△ Caution — Please read before use.
● This product is for Ages 15+. Never give it to children below the target age.
● This product contains small parts and batteries. Keep away from small children who might swallow them — risk of choking.
● The product has pointed or sharp parts. Take care when handling and storing to avoid unexpected injury.
● Do not use near the ear. Improper use may damage hearing.
● This product contains electronic components. If you use a pacemaker, keep the product away from your body.
● Do not stare at flashing LED light; it may cause discomfort.
《Improper use of batteries may cause overheating, rupture, or leakage. Observe the following:》
● Never use secondary (rechargeable) batteries.
● Do not mix old and new batteries or different types of batteries.
● Insert batteries with correct + and - polarity.

● This product is precision-made. Applying excessive force or dropping it may cause breakage. It contains precision electronic parts; do not drop, get wet, soil, or disassemble it. Also avoid use or storage in places of extremely high or low temperature. Dispose of plastic packaging immediately after opening.
